node_7.subject: Isabella Rodriguez
node_7.description: This is Isabella Rodriguez's plan for Monday February 13: wake up and complete the morning routine at 8:00 am, Open Hobbs Cafe at 8:00 am, Attend to the cafe's customers until lunchtime around 12:30 pm, Take a short break for lunch, possibly at home if time allows, between 12:30 pm and 1:00 pm, Continue serving customers at the cafe from 1:00 pm to 5:00 pm in preparation for the Valentine's Day party, Set up the party decorations and material for the upcoming event starting around 3:00 pm and finishing around 4:30 pm, Greet customers as they arrive for the Valentine's Day party from 5:00 pm to 7:00 pm, Wind down the cafe after the party at 7:00 pm, tidy up, and prepare for the next day.
